phonograms._comment: Rule NAME1 v4 — every Latin letter mapped to a DISTINCT, genuine Egyptian sign. Primary 24 uniliterals used where unambiguous; secondary/biliteral signs (also real, attested) used to break collisions, exactly as Ptolemaic scribes did when spelling foreign names like Ptolemy and Alexander into cartouches. See _reference for full Gardiner IDs and sources.

redirects._comment: Semantic redirect table — curated synonym mappings. When a word is not in the lexicon and not a known fallback, the engine checks here first. The trace shows REDIRECT → target so substitution is always visible. Intentionally approximate: logographic writing accepts nearest-meaning.
